items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember substituting for Larry Clinton's drummer on 'The Campbells Are Swinging'.

ctx.x: 'Love's Old Sweet Song', we brought those. We'll play those for you, 'Twelfth Street Rag.' And the 'Royal Garden Blues' which is really the 'Memphis Blues'. Okay, we'll play those for you. When Larry Clinton started his band, I guess it was just a recording band at first and apparently you were on the second recording session he had.
Well Larry Clinton came into the NBC because his records were selling. And NBC wanted a guy whose records Could sell. So that's why they got him.
To sort of tie in with RCA and NBC.
